Name: Mobile Catalogues
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url] adds a catalogues app that contains all in-game catalogs.

By default you must purchase the catalogues. Prices are all set to 10,000. You can adjust the prices or turn off the purchasing feature in the [b]config.json[/b] file.

Catalogs are now automatically added based on game data, names are just the catalog ID, since shops don't have names.

There are now show and hidden lists in the config, as well as a list of all catalogue that will be checked each time you load a save. You can copy and paste entries from the AllCatalagues list to either the ShownCatalogues or HiddenCatalogues list in the config and then restart the game.


Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url], does not use Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

﻿﻿A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
